name: io.github.HMAKT99/clawtank
title: ClawTank
description: Let agents see and drive a Mac: screenshots, clicks, typing, apps and virtual displays.

environmentVariables.name: CLAWTANK_AGENT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Agent token from ClawTank → Settings → Agents. Requires the ClawTank app running on this Mac.

environmentVariables.name: CLAWTANK_AGENT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Agent API address, if you changed its port.
